# ataila_project_backup_exports (Data Source)

A project's exports, newest first: downloadable packages built from its sets. An export is requested, and its package downloaded, in the portal only; nothing here carries a download link. Exports expire within days, so the list stays short.

Needs `project-backup-read-global` (or the admin key); a tenant-scoped token reads its own tenant's projects. Platform release 1.0.399 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The exports of a project still waiting to be downloaded in the portal.
data "ataila_project_backup_exports" "ready" {
  project_id = ataila_project.shop.id
  status     = "success"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Id of the project.

### Optional

- `status` (String) Only the exports in this status: `queued`, `running`, `success`, `failed` or `expired`.

### Read-Only

- `exports` (Attributes List) The matching exports, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exports))

<a id="nestedatt--exports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exports`

Read-Only:

- `bytes` (Number) The package's size in bytes, once it finished.
- `contents` (List of String) What is inside the package, one line per part.
- `created_at` (String) When the export was requested.
- `database` (String) What it carries of each database: `schema`, `data` (schema and data) or `both` (those and a full dump).
- `environments` (List of String) The environments it carries.
- `error` (String) Why it failed, as the run reported it.
- `expires_at` (String) When the download window closes (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `files` (Boolean) Whether it carries the object storage buckets.
- `finished_at` (String) When its run finished.
- `id` (String) The export's id.
- `sha256` (String) The package's SHA-256, once it finished.
- `source_set_ids` (List of String) The sets it was built from.
- `started_at` (String) When its run started.
- `status` (String) `queued`, `running`, `success`, `failed`, or `expired`.
